title: Log Aggregation Pipeline Simulator
description: Follow production logs from applications through collection, parsing, filtering, buffering, sharded indexing, and search. Trigger traffic spikes, parser failures, and slow indexing to see where backpressure builds and logs can be lost.

title: How Docker Works Under the Hood
description: Watch what really happens when you run docker run -p 8080:80 nginx, one layer at a time. Step down the whole stack: the CLI, the daemon, the registry pull, containerd, the OCI runtime bundle, runc, the running container, and the shared Linux kernel. Every stage shows the real low-level command you can run yourself, so it doubles as a tour of the primitives that make a container: namespaces, cgroups, and runc. A container is not a small VM, and this shows you why.

title: Webhook Delivery Simulator
description: Send a webhook through a production-style delivery flow. Change endpoint responses, watch retries and backoff, inspect real HMAC-SHA256 signatures, and redeliver the same message to see receiver-side deduplication.

title: Bounce Triage Simulator
description: Read a real SMTP bounce and decide what it is and what to do about it. Twelve genuine failures from Gmail, Outlook, Postfix and Proofpoint: hard bounces, soft bounces, content blocks, rate limits and spam complaints. Learn why the 4xx and 5xx class digit is a hint rather than the answer, which bounces to suppress permanently, which to retry, and what each mistake costs you in lost subscribers or lost sending reputation.

title: Binary Byte Simulator
description: Flip eight bits by hand and watch the number change, the way the wooden demonstrators in computing museums do it. Then switch modes and the same tiles become a chmod permission set and a subnet mask, so 755 and /26 stop being things to memorise. Count upward to watch a carry travel along the bits.

title: Simulador de Pipeline RAG
description: Veja um pipeline RAG funcionar por dentro. Ajuste o tamanho do chunk, o overlap, o top-k e o tipo de busca, ligue e desligue o grounding e indexe um documento malicioso para entender por que a resposta acerta, recusa, alucina ou sofre prompt injection.

title: Agentic Loop Simulator
description: Watch a coding agent run an agentic loop, one step at a time. A planner, a builder, and a judge cycle through plan, build, verify, and repeat until the goal is met. Toggle the separate judge off to see why an agent grading its own work ships confident bugs. An animation-first, interactive explainer of loop engineering and how it maps to Claude Code.

title: SQL Terminal Simulator
description: Practice SQL in an interactive browser terminal. Learn SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, DISTINCT, aggregates, GROUP BY, HAVING, JOINs, subqueries, and window functions against a small e-commerce schema, with single-table queries evaluated live and verified Postgres output.

title: PostgreSQL Terminal Simulator
description: Practice the psql tool and Postgres engine in an interactive browser terminal. Explore with meta-commands, read real EXPLAIN plans, add an index to turn a sequential scan into a bitmap index scan, and use BEGIN and ROLLBACK to make changes safe, all against a small e-commerce database with verified PostgreSQL output.

title: MongoDB Terminal Simulator
description: Practice MongoDB queries in an interactive browser terminal. Learn find and projections, query operators like $lt, $gt, and $in, sort, skip, limit, countDocuments, insert, update, delete, and the aggregation pipeline with $match, $group, and $sort, against a small e-commerce dataset that runs live in your browser.

title: Fork Bomb Simulator
description: Visualize how the infamous :(){ :|:& };: fork bomb works. Watch processes multiply exponentially, exhaust system resources, and learn how to protect against it with ulimit, cgroups, and systemd.

title: AWS VPC Networking Simulator
description: Learn AWS networking fundamentals with an interactive VPC simulator. Visualize how traffic flows through public and private subnets, understand NAT Gateways, Internet Gateways, and route tables.

title: DNS Resolution Simulator
description: Learn how DNS works with an interactive step-by-step simulator. Visualize the DNS hierarchy, understand caching at different levels, and see the difference between recursive and iterative queries.

title: Database Indexing Simulator
description: Learn how database indexes work with an interactive simulator. See the difference between full table scans and index seeks, understand B-tree structure, and learn when to create indexes.

title: Database Replication, Sharding & Scaling
description: Explore database replication, sharding, and scaling with an interactive simulator. Compare sync vs async replication, shard key choices, hot spots, failover behavior, read replicas, write scaling, connection pooling, cost, and latency.

title: PostgreSQL Wire Protocol Simulator
description: Visualize the PostgreSQL wire protocol with an interactive simulator. Step through TLS negotiation, StartupMessage, SCRAM authentication, simple queries, extended queries, RowDescription, DataRow streams, ErrorResponse, COPY, and ReadyForQuery.

title: Docker Terminal Simulator
description: Practice Docker commands in an interactive browser terminal. Learn images, containers, logs, exec, Dockerfile builds, volumes, networks, and Docker Compose with a live Docker daemon visualization.

title: Kubernetes Terminal Simulator
description: Practice Kubernetes commands in an interactive browser terminal. Learn kubectl contexts, nodes, Pods, Deployments, Services, rollouts, logs, exec, events, ConfigMaps, and cleanup workflows with a live cluster visualization.

title: Terraform Basics Simulator
description: Learn Terraform basics in an interactive browser lab. Read and edit the HCL config, run init, validate, plan, apply, and destroy, and watch state react to your edits. A free, hands-on way to learn infrastructure as code with no AWS account.

title: P90, P95 & P99 Latency Simulator
description: Learn latency percentiles with an interactive simulator. Generate request samples, visualize distributions, compare average latency with P50, P90, P95, and P99, and see how tail latency affects real users.

title: Kubernetes Networking / CNI Simulator
description: Visualize Kubernetes networking and CNI packet paths with an interactive simulator. Learn Pod-to-Pod routing, same-node and cross-node traffic, ClusterIP Services, EndpointSlices, headless Services, LoadBalancer, NodePort, kube-proxy, eBPF service routing, Ingress, NetworkPolicy, and internet egress.

title: Git Concepts Simulator
description: Practice Git in an interactive browser terminal with a visual repository model. Learn the working directory, staging area, local commits, branch pointers, remotes, fast-forward merges, fetch, and rebase.

title: JavaScript Promises & Async/Await Simulator
description: Visualize JavaScript promises, async/await, microtasks, task queues, setTimeout ordering, rejection handling, and Promise.all with an interactive event-loop simulator inspired by classic JavaScript visual guides.

title: OAuth/OIDC Flow Simulator
description: Visualize OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect flows with an interactive simulator. Learn authorization code + PKCE, state, nonce, redirect URI checks, ID tokens, access tokens, refresh tokens, scopes, UserInfo, and common auth failure modes.

title: SMTP Flow Simulator
description: Visualize how SMTP email delivery works from app submission through EHLO, STARTTLS, AUTH, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, recipient MX relay, retries, bounces, and inbox placement.

title: Message Queue Simulator
description: Visualize how message queues work across Kafka and RabbitMQ patterns. Explore producers, brokers, topics, partitions, exchanges, queues, consumer groups, lag, rebalancing, backpressure, ordering, and dead letter queues.

title: Caching Strategies Simulator
description: Learn caching fundamentals with an interactive simulator. Visualize cache hits, misses, eviction policies (LRU, LFU, FIFO), and understand write strategies.

title: Deployment Strategies Simulator
description: Learn deployment strategies like Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling Updates, and Recreate. Visualize how each strategy handles traffic routing, downtime, and rollbacks.

title: REST API vs GraphQL Simulator
description: Compare REST and GraphQL side-by-side. Understand over-fetching, under-fetching, the N+1 problem, and when to use each approach with interactive scenarios.

title: Horizontal vs Vertical Scaling Simulator
description: Interactive game to learn scaling strategies for web applications. Experiment with horizontal and vertical scaling, see the effects on performance, cost, and reliability with realistic pricing simulation and budget constraints.

title: BCDR Simulator
description: Learn Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery with interactive RTO/RPO planning, failover strategies, and disaster scenarios. Understand hot, warm, and cold DR sites.

title: SSL/TLS Handshake Simulator
description: Visualize how SSL/TLS handshakes work with certificate verification, key exchange, and cipher negotiation. Compare TLS 1.2 and 1.3 protocols.

title: Learn Linux - Interactive Tutorial
description: Master essential Linux commands through interactive lessons. Practice pwd, ls, cd, cat, grep, chmod, pipes, and more in a simulated terminal environment with 6 progressive lessons.

title: Load Balancer Algorithm Simulator
description: Learn how different load balancing algorithms distribute traffic across servers. Experiment with Round Robin, Least Connections, IP Hash, and more. See how load balancers handle failures and optimize performance.

title: Database Management Systems
description: Learn about different database types (SQL, NoSQL, Graph, Time-Series) and their use cases. Explore CAP theorem trade-offs and make informed database choices.

title: GitOps Workflow Simulator
description: Learn GitOps principles through interactive scenarios. Understand Git as source of truth, automated sync, and drift detection.

title: Bug Hunter
description: DevOps-themed Snake game where you control a bug that infects healthy servers. Grow longer with each infection, but avoid crashing into walls or yourself!

title: TCP vs UDP Simulator
description: Interactive visualization showing the differences between TCP's reliable connection-oriented protocol and UDP's fast connectionless approach. See the 3-way handshake, packet loss, and retransmissions in action.

title: DevOps Scorecard
description: Evaluate your DevOps skills across 8 key areas and generate a beautiful, shareable scorecard with personalized insights.

title: Microservices Architecture Simulator
description: Design and deploy microservices. See communication patterns, handle failures, and scale independently. Learn when to use microservices and understand the trade-offs.

title: Kubernetes Scheduler Challenge
description: Drag-and-drop Pods onto Nodes while honoring kube scheduling rules: resources, taints/tolerations, selectors, and topology spread.

title: Rate Limit Simulator
description: Learn API rate limiting, backoff strategies, and throttling with real-time visualization and interactive charts.

title: DDoS Attack Simulator
description: Educational simulator to understand how DDoS attacks work with stunning real-time visualizations, multiple attack vectors, and protection mechanisms.

title: Scalable Sentry
description: Tower defense game where you defend your infrastructure against waves of network traffic. Deploy servers, manage resources, and survive boss waves!

title: Network Packet Journey
description: Follow a single HTTP/HTTPS packet through the entire network stack with stunning animations. Learn DNS, TCP, TLS, CDN, load balancing, and more!

title: CI/CD Stack Generator
description: Spin the reels to generate your perfect (or perfectly cursed) DevOps stack!

title: Infra Tarot Cards
description: Draw mystical cards to discover your infrastructure destiny! Get humorous readings about your DevOps future.

title: You Might Be a DevOps Engineer If...
description: Auto-generating hilarious and painfully accurate DevOps memes. Each reload brings a new dose of reality!

title: Cards Against DevOps
description: A hilariously inappropriate DevOps party game. Fill in the blanks with the most outrageous DevOps scenarios!

title: Git Command Quiz
description: Test your Git knowledge with interactive scenarios covering branches, merges, rebases, conflicts, and the recovery commands you reach for under pressure.

title: Uptime Defender
description: Fast-paced SRE game where you defend your infrastructure uptime! Handle incoming incidents by adding nodes, rotating logs, failing over, restarting pods, and scaling databases.

title: Container Security Challenge
description: Six real docker run commands, each carrying a flag that hands an attacker the host. Click the dangerous ones, then see the actual escape path and what to grant instead. Covers the Docker socket, --privileged, host PID namespace, SYS_ADMIN and unconfined AppArmor, plus one command with nothing wrong with it.

title: Prometheus Query Builder (PromQL Playground)
description: Learn Prometheus Query Language (PromQL) with an interactive playground. Master label filtering, rate calculations, aggregations, and histogram quantiles with real-time query execution.

title: Service Mesh Traffic Simulator
description: Visualize how service mesh proxies handle traffic between microservices. Learn mTLS, traffic splitting, retries, circuit breakers, and explore Istio and Linkerd patterns.

title: Construa um RAG do Zero com Python, pgvector e um LLM Local
description: Monte um assistente que responde perguntas sobre seus próprios documentos, com citação de fonte, busca híbrida e avaliação automatizada. Tudo roda na sua máquina, sem chave de API e sem custo.

title: Criando e Conectando ao Seu Primeiro Servidor Linux
description: Suba um servidor Linux Ubuntu 24.04 na nuvem, configure a autenticação por chave SSH e aprenda a navegar pelo seu novo servidor. Este exercício usa a DigitalOcean, mas os passos funcionam com qualquer provedor de nuvem.

description: Implemente padrões de cache prontos para produção com Redis para melhorar drasticamente o desempenho e a escalabilidade da aplicação.

title: Load Balancing e Reverse Proxy com Nginx
description: Domine os padrões de load balancing e reverse proxy com o Nginx para construir uma infraestrutura resiliente e escalável.

title: Automação Completa de Servidor Web com Ansible

title: Implante um Droplet da DigitalOcean com Terraform
description: Aprenda os fundamentos de Infrastructure as Code implantando um servidor web simples na DigitalOcean usando Terraform. Perfeito para iniciantes começando sua jornada em IaC.

title: Observabilidade de Microsserviços com OpenTelemetry
description: Implemente uma observabilidade abrangente para microsserviços usando o OpenTelemetry para tracing distribuído, métricas e logging em múltiplos serviços.

title: VPC AWS com Terraform
description: Construa uma infraestrutura completa de VPC na AWS usando Terraform, com subnets públicas/privadas, NAT gateway e security groups.

title: Pipeline Completo de CI/CD com GitHub Actions
description: Laboratório prático: construa um pipeline de CI/CD de produção com GitHub Actions, incluindo testes, varredura de segurança, builds de container e implantação automatizada.

title: Configuração Completa de uma Stack de Monitoramento
description: Implante e configure o Prometheus e o Grafana para um monitoramento abrangente de aplicações e infraestrutura.

title: Quiz de Gerenciamento de Configuração com Ansible
description: Teste suas habilidades em Ansible com playbooks, roles, gerenciamento de inventário e cenários de automação para configuração de infraestrutura

title: GitOps com Argo CD: Quiz de Estrutura de Repositório Multi-Ambiente
description: Teste seu conhecimento sobre como estruturar repositórios Git para implantações com Argo CD em ambientes de dev, staging e produção. Aborda padrões de layout de repositório, ApplicationSets, overlays do Kustomize, arquivos de values do Helm e políticas de sincronização.

description: A habilidade de fazer contas de guardanapo que faz ou quebra uma entrevista de system design: transformar usuários em QPS, dados em armazenamento, tráfego em banda, e conhecer de cor os números de latência que todo engenheiro deveria saber.

title: Quiz de Fundamentos de CI/CD

description: Teste sua capacidade de colocar LLMs em produção: tokens e janela de contexto, temperature, embeddings, chunking, RAG, avaliação, alucinação, prompt injection, agentes e custo. Cenários reais, não definições decoradas.

description: Teste seus conhecimentos de Jenkins com perguntas sobre pipelines declarativos e scripted, sintaxe Groovy, agents, plugins, shared libraries e padrões de automação de CI/CD.

description: Aprenda conceitos de Kubernetes através de cenários práticos envolvendo pods, services, deployments e troubleshooting
